description: This Java class provides utility methods for constructing email-related data, such as HTML email templates with store information, logos, and localized messages, used within the sales manager web application.

classes.name: EmailUtils
classes.description: A utility class for generating email object maps with store details, localization, and logo paths for email templates.

methods.name: createEmailObjectsMap
methods.description: Constructs a map of email template tokens with store info, localized messages, and logo image references.
